title: "INTEGRATOR"
subtitle: "Peak detection, picking, and integration for targeted MRM mass spectrometry"
description: |
  INTEGRATOR is the stand-alone peak-integration application of the MRMhub pipeline. It reads

  quantitation in the QUANT R package.
toc: false
---

**INTEGRATOR** is the stand-alone peak-integration module of the MRMhub pipeline. It reads
converted mzML files, detects and integrates MRM peaks across all samples, supports interactive
review and refinement of the results, and exports tables for quantitation.

It is distributed as a self-contained executable for macOS and Windows and requires no
installation and no separate runtime. Retaining one copy in each analysis project folder
keeps the project reproducible.

::: {.callout-note}
INTEGRATOR is not required to use the QUANT R package; QUANT also imports directly from vendor
outputs (MassHunter, Skyline). See the
[QUANT documentation ↗](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub/quant/).
:::

## Next step in the pipeline

Once INTEGRATOR produces `long.csv`, pass it to the QUANT R package for ISTD
normalisation, drift/batch correction, calibration, QC, and reporting:

```r
import_data_mrmhub(path = "path/to/long.csv", import_metadata = TRUE)
```

See the [QUANT documentation ↗](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub/quant/) to continue.
